meta.author:
讚美之泉
詞曲：曾祥怡

lines.a: 祢是我的主 引我走正義路
lines.b: Lord, You are my guide, the shepherd of my life

lines.a: 高山或低谷 都是祢在保護
lines.b: Through the hills and valleys, You're always by my side

lines.a: 萬人中唯獨 祢愛我認識我
lines.b: Calling me by name, You've chosen me with love

lines.a: 永遠不變的應許 這一生 都是祝福
lines.b: Blessing me abundantly, Your promise will never change

lines.a: 一步又一步 這是恩典之路
lines.b: Every step we take, You lead us with Your grace

lines.a: 祢愛 祢手 將我緊緊抓住
lines.b: Your love, Your hand will hold us close to You

lines.a: 一步又一步 這是盼望之路
lines.b: Every step we take, You lead us with Your grace

lines.a: 祢愛 祢手 牽引我走這人生路
lines.b: Your love, Your hand will guide us through the path of grace

lines.a: 祢愛 祢手 牽引我走這人生路
lines.b: Your love, Your hand will guide us through the path of grace
